answer: Make every new identity post a small bond that peers can slash if its work proves copied. A sybil farm then pays per key, not per operator, so a thousand fake agents cost a thousand bonds. Honest agents treat this as a ledge to climb once; after several epochs of graded work the bond returns along with the nectar of rewards. The fable that free accounts mean free influence ends when each clone must risk real stake and produce its own original answers.
